1. (Currently Amended) A system (100) for enabling review of a medical image, comprising:
- an image interface (120) for obtaining the medical image (042);
- a user interface subsystem (140) for enabling a user to apply one or more graphical elements (310) to the medical image during the review of the medical image, thereby establishing application data representing application of the one or more graphical elements to the medical image, wherein the application data is automatically processed by the system to identify specific anatomical structures or pathological findings marked by the graphical elements; and
- a reporting subsystem (180) for:
i) accessing a medical database (060) comprising medical information items (062-066) which each represent medical reference information (400-414) that is specific to the identified anatomical structures or pathological findings,
ii) retrieving a medical information item (062) from the medical database based on association data, the association data linking the application of the one or more graphical elements, as represented by the application data, to the medical information item through __a predefined mapping between graphical element characteristics and medical reference information__, and
iii) generating a report (182) that includes __the medical reference information integrated with the measurement data or positional data derived from the graphical elements applied to the medical image__.

2. (Currently Amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the medical information item (062) is associated with a codified version of the medical reference information (420), and wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the codified version of the medical reference information __in combination with the application data__ in generating the report (182).

3. (Currently Amended) The system (100) according to claim 2, wherein:
- the user interface subsystem (140) is arranged for displaying the medical reference information as a selectable graphical element (400-414) to the user __in proximity to or overlaid upon the marked region of the medical image__, and
- the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the codified version of the medical reference information (420) __and the specific location or measurement data of the graphical elements__ in generating the report (182) based on the user selecting the selectable graphical element.

4. (Currently Amended) The system (100) according to claim 2, wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using a macro (080) __that processes the application data and the associated medical reference information__ to generate the codified version of the medical reference information (420) from the medical reference information (400-414).

5. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 4, wherein the medical information item (062) comprises the macro (080) or a reference to the macro.

6. (Currently Amended) The system (100) according to claim 3, wherein the medical information items (062-066) are cross-referenced via hyperlinks __that are contextually relevant to the anatomical structures or findings marked by the graphical elements__, and wherein the user interface subsystem (140) is arranged for enabling the user to interactively browse to another medical information item by selecting a hyperlink in the selectable graphical element (410-414).

7. (Currently Amended) The system (100) according to claim 3, wherein the selectable graphical element is a selectable overlay (410, 412) __that displays information specific to the marked anatomical region__, and wherein the user interface subsystem is arranged for displaying the medical reference information in the form of text (410, 412) or graphics (414) in the selectable overlay __that corresponds to the location and type of graphical element applied__.

8. (Currently Amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more graphical elements (310) provide a measurement tool for enabling the user to perform a measurement on the medical image (042) using the user interface subsystem, and wherein the association data is constituted at least in part by measurement data (312) representing the measurement __and the system automatically correlates the measurement data to corresponding medical reference information items__.

9. (Currently Amended) The system (100) according to claim 8, wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the measurement data (312) __in conjunction with the associated medical reference information__ in generating the report (182).

10. (Currently Amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the association data is constituted at least in part by a plurality of rules __stored in the medical database__ each linking a respective one of the one or more graphical elements (310) to a respective one of the medical information items (062-066) __based on the type, position, or characteristics of the graphical element__.

11. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the application data represents one or more of the group of:
- a type of the one or more graphical elements (310);
- a position of the one or more graphical elements in the medical image; and
- an image structure (044) marked by the one or more graphical elements.

12. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more graphical elements (310) comprise one or more of the group of: a marker, an annotation and a measurement tool (310).

13. (Previously presented) Workstation or imaging apparatus comprising the system according to claim 1.

14. (Currently Amended) A method (200) for enabling review of a medical image, comprising:
- obtaining (210) the medical image;
- enabling (220) a user to apply one or more graphical elements to the medical image during the review of the medical image, thereby establishing application data representing application of the one or more graphical elements to the medical image, __wherein the system automatically processes the graphical elements to identify specific anatomical structures or pathological findings__;
- accessing (230) a medical database comprising medical information items which each represent medical reference information __specific to anatomical structures and pathological findings__;
- retrieving (240) a medical information item from the medical database based on association data, the association data linking the application of the one or more graphical elements, as represented by the application data, to the medical information item __through a predefined mapping between graphical element characteristics and medical reference information__; and
- generating (250) a report based on the medical information item __that integrates the medical reference information with the measurement data or positional data derived from the graphical elements applied to the medical image__.

15. (Currently Amended) A __non-transitory__ computer program product (270) comprising instructions for causing a processor system to perform the method according to claim 14.
